     2018 年回顧                                               REVIEW OF 2018
     2018 年的中國房地產，從業者並不輕鬆。成交                                The real estate industry in China was not easy for market participants during
     總額以 15 萬億再創新高，然而回歸居住屬性的                                2018. The total sales volumn of RMB15 trillion marked another breakthrough,
     樓市，上行的內在動因與邏輯已與過往迥異，                                   however, a market guided by the principle of “housing is for living” has caused
     城市、板塊間的差距進一步擴大。控房價、去                                   significant changes to fundamental drivers and logic, with the gap between
     槓桿的組合拳觸發購買情緒的整體降溫。公司                                   different cities and sectors expanding. The combined effect of price controls and
     努力把握城市輪動與細分市場的結構性機遇，                                   de-leveraging has cooled down overall buying sentiment. The Company strived
     全年實現合約銷售 2,006 億，同比增長 28.5%。                           to seize the structural opportunities arising from differing city dynamics and
                                                            market segments, recording contracted sales of RMB200.6 billion during the
                                                            year, representing a year-on-year growth of 28.5%.

     除了 85% 以上的銷售回款率，公司更憑藉出色                                In addition to maintaining a cash collection ratio of more than 85%, the
     的融資能力，以真金白銀把握行業調整期的戰                                   Company has also leveraged on its outstanding financing capacity, to take
     略主動。在資本市場，選准窗口，實現境內外                                   strategic initiatives to enhance our capital structure during a period of industry
     債券的最優發行；在銀行端，高信用保障了額                                   consolidation. In the capital markets, we have accurately seized the window
     度與利率的雙支持－－總行級授信總額超 2,000                               of opportunity to complete favorable issuances of both domestic and overseas

財務狀況                                             FINANCIAL POSITION

風險管理組織體系：龍湖集團的風險管理組織                 Risk management organizational system: The risk management organizational
體系是董事會領導下的三道基本防線，即公司                 system of Longfor Group consists of three basic lines of defense under the

由集團職能部門負責人組成的，CEO 為組長、               Company as the first line of defense; the risk management team consisting of

審核委員會和內審中心為第三道防線。董事會                 team leader and CFO as deputy team leader as the second line of defense; and
是風險管理的最終責任機構，有權對集團風險                 the Audit Committee and internal audit centre as the third line of defense.
管理的政策制度及應對方案進行指引和最終決                 The Board shall be the ultimate accountability body of risk management,

風險管理小組負責不斷完善風險管理體系，執                 and internal audit centre are authorized by the Board to advise on and monitor

      12. 投資物業（續）                                            12. INVESTMENT PROPERTIES (Continued)
            投資物業均位於中國。                                           The investment properties are all situated in the PRC.

            本集團投資物業於轉撥之日以及報告日                                    The fair values of the Group’s investment properties at dates of transfer
            期的公平值乃基於由與本集團並無關連                                    and reporting dates have been arrived at on the basis of valuations carried
            的一家獨立合資格專業估值師第一太平                                    out on those dates by Savills Valuation and Professional Services Limited,
            戴 維 斯 估 值 及 專 業 顧 問 有 限 公 司（其 於                      a firm of independent qualified professional valuers not connected to the
            相關地點類似物業的估值上擁有適當資                                    Group, who have appropriate qualifications and recent experiences in the
            格及新近經驗）於該等日期進行的估值編                                   valuation of similar properties in the relevant locations.
            製。

            在估計物業的公平值時，其目前用途為                                    In estimating the fair value of the properties, the highest and best use of
            該等物業帶來最高價值及和最佳用途。                                    the properties is their current use.

  董 事 認 為， 收 購 該 等 公 司 並 不 構 成 業          In the opinion of directors, the acquisitions of these companies does not
  務，故本公司董事將有關交易釐定為透                       constitute businesses. Therefore, the transactions were determined by
  過收購附屬公司收購資產及負債，而非                       the directors of the Company to be acquisition of assets and liabilities
  國際財務報告準則第 3 號「業務合併」所界                   through acquisition of subsidiaries rather than a business combination as
  定的業務合併。                                 defined in IFRS 3 Business Combinations.

            本集團管理資本以確保本集團的實體能                                        The Group manages its capital to ensure that entities in the Group will

            餘為股東帶來最大回報。                                              shareholders through the optimisation of the debt and equity balance.

            據）、現金及現金等價物淨額以及本公司                                       28 and 29 respectively, net of cash and cash equivalents and equity
            擁有人應佔權益（包括已發行股本、儲備                                       attributable to owners of the Company, comprising issued share capital,
            及保留盈利）。                                                  reserves and retained earnings.

            本公司董事定期審閱資本架構。作為該                                        The directors of the Company review the capital structure on a regular
            審閱的一部分，本公司董事考慮資本成                                        basis. As part of this review, the directors of the Company consider the
            本及與各類資本有關的風險，並採取適                                        cost of capital and the risks associated with each class of capital, and take
            當措施平衡整體資本架構。                                             appropriate actions to balance its overall capital structure.
